issue.title: Partial refunds ignore the order discount

sections.name: Summary
text: A partial refund recomputes the amount without the order's discount.

sections.name: Observed
text: Refunding 1 of 3 items on an order with a 10 percent discount returns the full item price.

sections.name: Expected
text: The refund equals the item price minus that item's share of the discount.

sections.name: When
text: any partial refund on a discounted order (always)

sections.name: Cause
text: The refund path reads unit_price from the line item and never calls the discount allocator. (verified)

sections.name: Root cause
text: Symptom: the refund amount is too high (`src/billing/refund.py:88`)
1. `src/billing/refund.py:74`: refund_amount() sums unit_price for the chosen lines.
2. `src/billing/totals.py:31`: allocate_discount() is called only from order_total().
Root cause: `src/billing/totals.py:19`: discount shares are computed at checkout and never stored on the line item.

sections.name: Do not fix by
list: capping the refund at the order total, which hides the wrong amount
catching the over-refund error in the payment call

sections.name: Reproduce
numbered: Create an order of 3 items with a 10 percent discount code.
Compare the refund amount with the item price.

sections.name: Fix
text: Store the discount share on each line item at checkout and subtract it in refund_amount().

sections.name: Prove
text: A test that refunds one discounted item fails on the unchanged code and passes after the fix.

sections.name: Evidence
list: `src/billing/refund.py:74`: return sum(line.unit_price for line in lines)

sections.name: Affected
text: customers who return part of a discounted order; owner: acme-api, billing
